title.en: An Act Authorizing the Municipality of Naga, Province of Camarines Sur, to Acquire and Operate An Electric Plant Within Its Territory and Form a Corporation, If Necessary, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
Subject to the conditions established in this Act and the provisions of Act Numbered
Twenty-three hundred and seven and amendments thereof, applicable thereto, there is hereby granted to the
municipality of Naga, Province of Camarines Sur, authority to acquire, construct,maintain, and operate on all
the streets, public thoroughfares, and public places within the limits of the municipality mentioned,
machinery, poles, wires, and all necessary appurtenances for the transmission of currents for electric power,
heat, and light within said municipality of Naga, Camarines Sur, for municipal, domestic, or industrial uses
and for any other use to which electricity may be put, and to charge and collect a schedule of prices for the use
of the same: Provided, That said prices shall be subject to rules provided by Act of the Philippine Legislature
or by entities or authorities authorized by law, and shall in no case exceed thirty centavos per kilowatt:
Provided, further, That this authority shall not take effect until the municipality of the Naga shall have
obtained from the Public Utility Commission or any other authority acting in its stead certificate showing the
public necessity and convenience of the same, in accordance with the purpose of section twenty-three of Act
Numbered Twenty-three hundred and seven: Provided. finally, That if the municipality of Naga does not file
the proper application with the Public Utility Commission within two years from the date of the approval of
this Act, this authority shall become null and void.

In case its interests be better served thereby, the municipality of Naga is authorized to form a
corporation under the provisions of the Corporation Law, whose purpose shall be the acquisition and
operation of the electric plant referred to in the preceding section. The municipality of Naga shall accquire an
interest in the corporation so formed of not less than fifty-one per centum of the capital stock, and the
remainder of the shares of stock shall be offered to other entities and private individuals at a price not below
par: Provided, however, That in case an electric plant legally exists and operste in the locality at the time when
the public electric light, heat, and power service is to be established, the municipality of Naga or the
corporation formed by it for this purpose shall acquire such existing electric plant at a price which shall in no
case exceed the actual cost, upon approval of the Public Utility Commission or its legal successor.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 24, 1921.
